experimentName.title: Experiment name
experimentName.description: Name shown in Langfuse experiments; dataset run name derives from it unless runName is set.

runName.title: Exact dataset run name (optional)
runName.description: Exact Langfuse dataset-run name. Defaults to experimentName + timestamp.

harness.title: Harness configuration
harness.description: kind picks the adapter (claude-code for now); model is an OpenRouter id.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Parallel sessions inside this run (rule of thumb: 4-8 per CPU core, 1 core per 4GB).

perItemTimeoutSecs.title: Per-item timeout (seconds)
perItemTimeoutSecs.description: Hard kill for one session; dataset item metadata.maxTurns can vary turns per case.

itemLimit.title: Item limit (0 = all)
itemLimit.description: Run only the first N items after filtering.

categories.title: Category filter
categories.description: Only run items whose metadata.category is listed. Empty = all.

mcpUrl.title: MCP server URL
mcpUrl.description: Hosted MCP endpoint; per-item metadata.tools maps to ?tools=.

useOpenRouterProxy.title: LLM via Apify OpenRouter proxy
useOpenRouterProxy.description: On the platform, sessions authenticate to the OpenRouter proxy with the run's APIFY_TOKEN (no external keys). Disable for local runs to use your own Claude auth.

createDemoDataset.title: Create demo dataset if missing
createDemoDataset.description: Seed a 3-item demo dataset when datasetName does not exist.

langfuseBaseUrl.title: Langfuse base URL
langfuseBaseUrl.description: Falls back to LANGFUSE_BASE_URL env var.

langfusePublicKey.title: Langfuse public key
langfusePublicKey.description: Falls back to LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY env var.

langfuseSecretKey.title: Langfuse secret key
langfuseSecretKey.description: Falls back to LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY env var.
